snippet.title: Announcement Trailer |  "Some of You May Die"
snippet.description:
Build a squad of ultra-powerful heroes with synergized abilities and watch them devastate the enemy team in this new PVP Autobattler.

You begin with an empty battle field and are provided a choice of heroes and upgrades to purchase from the shop.
Stacking multiple heroes of the same type lead them to level up.  Heroes of a higher level are much more powerful than their lower-level counterparts, so you must choose carefully if you want to invest deeply in a few heroes or try to overwhelm your opponent with quantity.
Upgrades function similarly to hero leveling.  Upgrades stack on any given hero, and more stacks of the upgrade leads to much more powerful effects.
Want an archer with wicked fast attack speed and poison arrows? You can do that! Or a Summoner that passes on his upgrades to his summons? That's possible too.
The upgrade system provides many synergies but you must be careful to counter your opponent's strategy.

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4124920/Some_of_You_May_Die/
